title: Log the malformed-days_of_week fallback in StageDefinitionCodec.decode instead of silently defaulting to []
why: This legacy-quartet fallback (pre-`schedule`-column documents) swallows any jsonDecode/cast failure on days_of_week and silently substitutes an empty day list, changing a family's stage-due schedule with no AppLogger trail. Nobody could diagnose why a days_of_week schedule stopped firing for a given track.
recommendation: Log via AppLogger (including the raw malformed value, at debug/warn level) before falling back to const [].
acceptance_criteria: Test feeds a malformed days_of_week string into decode() and asserts an AppLogger call occurs alongside the [] fallback.
